selection: First four deck indices, paired adjacent and reversed, chosen before new outcomes. Bounded diagnostic only, not a representative meta sample.
rules: Run each planned attempt once; no label/seed search or replacement of rejected games.

This plan is diagnostic only; any future training model must explicitly bind this holdout instead of using the existing random split.
If rejection dominates, prioritize common blockers before scaling; if coverage is sparse, design a future schedule without changing this one.
